variants.name: refusal-on-click
variants.why: The third Add to shortlist stays enabled; pressing it adds nothing and only then shows why.

variants.name: plain-wording
variants.why: The empty state says "Nothing found", the count reads "1 tool on your shortlist", and the limit is guidance that is always visible.

variants.name: request-on-page
variants.why: The demo request action is beside Review shortlist on the page: the brief does not place it inside the dialog.

variants.name: shortlist-panel-lists-tools
variants.why: The Shortlist panel also lists the chosen tools, so a chosen tool is shown in two rows; every row button is identified by its row, not by a name of its own.

variants.name: full-button-label
variants.why: While the shortlist is full, the other tools show a disabled "Shortlist full: remove a tool first" instead of Add to shortlist; that label is the reason.

variants.name: request-closes-dialog
variants.why: The demo request action closes the dialog and the statement appears on the page beside the shortlist.
